name: Claude apps (web, desktop, mobile)

surfaces.name: Custom skill upload (Free, Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise; code execution on)
steps: Turn on code execution in Claude's settings.
Open Customize, then Skills, and select Upload a skill.
Choose design-dna-claude-skill.zip. It holds one top-level folder, reverse-design/.
Team and Enterprise owners can provision the skill for the whole organization instead.

prerequisites: Any Claude plan with code execution turned on

docs.title: Use skills in Claude
docs.facts: Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise; requires code execution. Customize > Skills > Upload a skill takes a ZIP of the skill folder. Uploads are private to the account; Team and Enterprise owners can provision skills for the organization.
